## Context / Problem

The epic's last acceptance criterion is a production check. After deploy, one plan review per engine must complete on a live ticket through the production MCP server, with the verdict, engine, model and attestation recorded. Unit tests cannot show that the deployed server, its signing environment and its Bedrock credentials work with the new engine and models.

## Approach

**Preconditions:**
- The engine children have landed: switch [rebar:skilled-cepevorous-naga], agentic arm [rebar:nickel-ferric-llama], adapter [rebar:confident-snooty-stinkpot], attestation engine [rebar:foliated-oceangoing-parrot], surfaces [rebar:churlish-zircon-rhea] and harness [rebar:antifungal-amenable-mite].
- The production MCP server runs a commit that contains them. This is confirmed read-only: an SSM `cat /var/lib/rebar/mcp-deployed-sha` on the host (`aws ssm send-command --profile frontier`) must name a commit with `git merge-base --is-ancestor <surfaces commit> <deployed sha>` true. Autodeploy picks up `main` within minutes; nothing is deployed by hand.

**Target ticket:** `mindless-misogynic-nematode`, an open, unclaimed task in this epic that has never been plan-reviewed. A review only adds a REVIEW_RESULT sidecar and, on PASS, a plan-review attestation, and the ticket needs a review before anyone claims it anyway.

**Runs.** Through the production MCP server (the `rebar` MCP tools this session uses), call `review_plan_start(ticket_id, engine="pipeline")`, then poll `gate_status(job_id)` until terminal and `plan_review_status`. Then repeat with `engine="agentic"`. The pipeline run goes first so the agentic run is not shortened by a reuse shortcut: shortcuts are pipeline-only and stay off under `agentic`. No production configuration changes; both runs use the explicit per-call argument.

**Recorded** in one comment on the epic `pompous-vitriolic-macaw`, per run: the job id, the terminal `gate_status`, the verdict, the engine (`coverage.engine`, absent = pipeline), the model, whether an attestation was signed, `plan_review_status`'s `verdict` and `engine` after the run, the completion timestamp in PST, and the deployed SHA. A run that ends INDETERMINATE is recorded with its `resolution_class` and investigated before this ticket closes.

## Scope

None. This is an operational verification with no repository file changes. Evidence lives in a comment on the epic.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] [non-codebase] One production `review_plan_start` run per engine completes on `mindless-misogynic-nematode`. The job ids, verdicts, engines, models, attestation status, deployed SHA and PST completion timestamps are recorded in a comment on the epic `pompous-vitriolic-macaw`.
  provenance: environment=production MCP server on i-00880b2c7f13527c5; principal=this session's rebar MCP client token; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — the runs go through the deployed server, its signing environment and its Bedrock credentials
